name: M5.AnchoredTupleCount.anchored_tuple_divisibility
statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (T d k : ℕ) (t : Fin k → Fin (T / d)), (P ∣ 1 + M5.ArithmeticTuple.tuplePolynomial T d k t ↔ AdjoinRoot.mk P (M5.ArithmeticTuple.tuplePolynomial T d k t) = 1)
queries: finite set cardinality bijection natural division
guidance: Use AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_zero for divisibility. Ring hom preserves addition and1, and the quotient is of characteristic2. No monicity/irreducibility needed. Return only tactic lines without leading by. Preserve the exact statement.
